lastChange.note: Questions 16 and 17 ruled (5 Oct). The ID card and the certificate take the PINTAR wordmark in place of «PINTAR SELALU» as a brand correction, nothing else changed (round 2 grammars, measured before and after). There is no second mark; the tab icon is a plain PINTAR-green square (assets/AppIcon/), a functional identifier, not a logo. Helvetica Neue 65 Medium stays canonical, and the font licence must be verified before the master is made. Prepared only; nothing applied to PINTAR.
